name: shots/missile
description: Ground missile v2 (w15-WEAPONLOOK2): hand-drawn native rocket — a silver nose cone on a white body with canted stabiliser fins and a flickering orange/amber exhaust stub at the left; the fly frame swaps the flame colour only (same silhouette). Reads as a finned rocket, not a smooth bolt — separates it from torpedo, basic and twin (w15-WEAPONLOOK § 6).
